resources.name: Okta - SSO - Attempt to Create Administrative API Token
resources.description:
Identifies an attempt to create an Okta API token by an administrative user. 
An attacker that has managed to compromise an Okta administrator user may attempt to create an Okta API token to maintain persistence and abuse it to perform administrative actions within the Okta environment. Such actions may include creating user accounts or downgrading the organization's authentication security posture by disabling Okta security rules or policies.
